annotations.title: Pause or resume the planned sites

description: Use this when the user has confirmed a plan_bulk_pause plan. Returns each site's outcome: paused or resumed, already so, or refused with the website's reason (a resume that does not fit the plan's running monitors is refused, the others still go ahead). Safe to repeat: the same plan id returns the first result. Not for deciding which sites: call plan_bulk_pause first.

confirm.description: The plan's confirm sentence, exactly as returned; show it to the user first.
